text: Authority is being sought to increase the Approved 2019 Operating Budget for the Association of Community Centres for the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre by $400,000 gross, $0 net, fully funded by Section 37 community benefits to provide one-time funding for capital improvements at the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre, in coordination with adjacent planned public realm and open space improvements being delivered as part of implementation of the Bathurst Quay Neighbourhood Plan. The Bathurst Quay Neighbourhood Plan is the product of more than two years of community consultation including over fifty meetings with dozens of local groups, and was adopted by City Council in July 2017 (Item TE25.55) and June 2018 (Item TE33.9). Near-term implementation of the Neighbourhood Plan is already underway: the Ireland Park Foundation has moved into an underutilized heritage building by the water; and…

City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council increase the Approved 2019 Operating Budget for the Association of Community Centres for the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre by $400,000.00 gross, $0 net, fully funded by Section 37 community benefits related to the development at 495-517 Wellington Street West (Source Account: XR3026-3701005) to provide one-time funding for capital improvements at the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre. (Cost Centre: NP0231)
